name: instant-split
description: MERN monorepo root for InstantSplit application

scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run start dev --workspace=server"
scripts.trace: npx concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=client" "LOG_API_REQUESTS=true npm run start dev --workspace=server"
scripts.clean-install: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json client/node_modules client/package-lock.json server/node_modules server/package-lock.json && npm install
